[LTES.7.5] The DS author-facing test surface is `.dstest` — a declarative
input→output relation over a program, specified in
[LTSL] and compiled to the `Test*` / `Oracle*`
test atoms ([RDSC.7.1]). A test is the top-level `test` block ([LGRA.21]), written
inline in a `.ds` beside the rules it exercises or collected in a `.dstest` file;
one grammar backs both. A test needs no capability directive — it is bound to its
project and adopts the program-under-test's dialect ([LTSL.2]).
